title: Review web labels and naming
change_reason: Original source-grounded pilot draft; human review pending.
purpose: Guide a bounded review of visible control labels, accessible names, and requested form input.
inputs: Rendered controls and computed accessible names
procedure: Retrieve current approved claims and inspect their limitations
Compare visible wording and names for controls within scope
Check requested-entry guidance in the rendered form
Record observations, artifact reference and the exact knowledge revision used
outputs: Scoped critique with cited evidence and unresolved findings
quality_checks: Separate normative requirements from informative explanation
Do not claim full WCAG conformance from two checks
